description_en: Queries the list of available LLM model codes for a specified model provider. It supports filtering by LLM code, model brand, recommendation level, and recommendation status, and returns model information such as the model name, description, release time, features, inference modality, pricing, credit multiplier, and risk type
description_zh: 查询指定模型提供商下可用的 LLM 模型编码列表，支持按 LLM 编码、模型品牌、推荐档位、是否推荐等条件筛选，并返回模型名称、描述、发布时间、特性、推理模态、价格、积分倍率、风险类型等模型信息
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center list-model-provider-llm-codes --provider-name moonshot --provider-template-id pt-xxx-001 --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListModelProviderLlmCodes

parameters.help_en: The name of the model provider
parameters.name: provider_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the provider template
parameters.name: provider_template_id

parameters.help_en: The LLM code used for fuzzy match filtering
parameters.help_zh: LLM 编码，用于模糊匹配筛选
parameters.name: llm_code

parameters.help_en: The list of model brands in a JSON array string. Supports multi-select filtering. Models matching any of the specified brands are returned
parameters.help_zh: 模型品牌列表（JSON 数组字符串），多选筛选，命中任一即返回
parameters.name: model_brands

parameters.help_en: The list of recommendation levels. This parameter takes effect only for wuying-plan. Models matching any of the specified levels and meeting other filter conditions such as region and brand are returned. If this parameter is not specified or an empty array is passed, models are not filtered by recommendation level
parameters.help_zh: 推荐档位列表，仅对 wuying-plan 生效。命中任意一个所选档位，并与地域、品牌等其他筛选条件取交集；不传或空数组不按档位筛选
parameters.name: recommended_levels

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to filter models by recommendation status. If this parameter is not specified, models are not filtered by recommendation status
parameters.help_zh: 是否推荐模型过滤，不传则不过滤
parameters.name: recommended

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 1000. Maximum value: 1000
parameters.help_zh: 每页数量，不传默认 1000，上限 1000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从 1 开始，不传默认 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The display language of the model. Valid values: zh-CN (Simplified Chinese), en-US (English), ja-JP (Japanese), and zh-TW (Traditional Chinese). Default value: zh-CN. Currently, zh-TW returns Simplified Chinese, and ja-JP returns English. If the model is not included in Model Studio or the English text is missing, the original source text is retained without automatic translation
parameters.help_zh: 模型展示语言。取值：zh-CN（简体中文）、en-US（英文）、ja-JP（日语）、zh-TW（繁体中文）。未传默认 zh-CN；当前 zh-TW 返回简体中文，ja-JP 返回英文。百炼未收录或英文文案缺失时保留原来源文案，不自动翻译
parameters.name: language

Data.description_zh: 分页数据对象，包含模型 LLM 信息列表

CreditMultiplier.description_en: The credit consumption multiplier. An empty value indicates that the model does not participate in credit billing
CreditMultiplier.description_zh: 积分消耗系数（倍率）。为空表示该模型不参与积分计费

Max.description_en: The upper limit of the multiplier. An empty value indicates no upper limit. For example, if the minimum value is 1 and the maximum value is empty, it is displayed as starting from 1x
Max.description_zh: 倍率上限。为空表示无上限，如 Min=1、Max 为空展示为 1x 起
Max.title_en: 倍率上限。为空表示无上限，如 Min=1、Max 为空展示为 1x 起
Max.title_zh: 倍率上限。为空表示无上限，如 Min=1、Max 为空展示为 1x 起

Min.description_en: The lower limit of the multiplier. If this value is equal to the maximum value, the multiplier is fixed. For example, if both the minimum and maximum values are 2, it is displayed as 2x
Min.description_zh: 倍率下限。与 Max 相等时为固定倍率，如 Min=Max=2 展示为 2x
Min.title_en: 倍率下限。与 Max 相等时为固定倍率，如 Min=Max=2 展示为 2x
